name: Camping Steinplatte
beschreibung: The Camping Steinplatte is located in the municipality of Waidring in the district of Kitzbühel in Tirol. The campsite offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. The sanitary facilities are modern and are cleaned regularly. In the surrounding area there are numerous hiking and cycling trails. In winter, the Steinplatte ski area is in the immediate vicinity. Cross-country skiers also get their money's worth on the groomed trails. The site is ideal for a relaxing holiday in nature.
